name: content-repurposer
description: Reverse-engineers videos, transcripts, and drafts into research-validated, platform-ready clip packages, then cuts the MP4s from the package's EDL and builds standalone-slide Canva carousels. Paste-ready native copy for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, LinkedIn, Substack, and beehiiv.

creator_name.title: Your name
creator_name.description: The name that goes on your content, used for carousel bylines and quotable lines.

content_pillars.title: Your content pillars
content_pillars.description: The 3 to 6 themes you post about, separated by commas. Example: home cooking, budget travel, small business money.

voice_notes.title: Your voice
voice_notes.description: How your copy should sound: tone, phrases you use, words to avoid, emoji policy. A few sentences is enough. Leave blank to use the default voice.

canva_template_id.title: Canva carousel template
canva_template_id.description: The design ID or link of the Canva design to build carousels from, sized 1080x1350. Only needed for Carousel Builder. Leave blank if you won't make carousels.

burn_box_color.title: Burned-in text box color
burn_box_color.description: Box color behind burned-in overlay text, as 0xRRGGBB@opacity. Only used by Clip Cutter.

burn_font.title: Burned-in text font
burn_font.description: Path to a .ttf or .otf brand font for burned-in text. Leave blank to use DejaVu Sans.

content_database.title: Content database
content_database.description: Name or link of the Notion, Airtable or sheet you track posts in. Leave blank to skip syncing.
